title: Add test_wave.py asserting wave('sun') returns expected value
body:
Create tests/agile/test_wave.py with a single test function test_wave_sun that imports wave from orgos/agile/wave and asserts wave('sun') == 'wave to sun'. Use pytest.

Files: tests/agile/test_wave.py

Done: test passes.

votes.justification: My estimate remains 1 because the story is purely adding a test file with one assertion against a trivial function, with zero implementation risk. The 5-point vote lacks justification, so it does not raise new concerns.
The devsecops estimate of 5 appears to be an outlier without justification; the task remains a trivial one-file addition with zero complexity. I hold my estimate at 1.
My peer architect and test correctly identified this as trivial — no secrets or security concerns in a single test file. I adjust my estimate down.
